items.question: What ritual repetition is enjoined upon the one worshipped by the gods?
premises: The practice is situated in the mass of syllables on the forehead.
The act must be performed one hundred thousand times.
The injunction is addressed to one worshipped by the gods.
items.inference: The one worshipped by the gods must perform a hundred-thousandfold repetition focused on the forehead syllables.
uncertainties: The specific mantra or syllables constituting the forehead mass are not named in this verse.
items.plain_english: O you worshipped by the gods, having performed a hundred thousand repetitions situated in the mass of syllables on the forehead...
